title: Old Parish Records — Stage B structured marriage record
description: DRAFT 2026-09-29 (Schema Steward) for Stephen QC — not locked. Structured Trauungen/Heiraten fields from Stage A diplomatic. Columns 1:1 with lank-st-stephanus-marriage-csv v1.1.0 (→ lank.stg_marriages) plus the shared Stage B envelope of opr-baptism-record / opr-death-record (pipeline links, multi-leaf crops, stage_b_status, expanded_latin after transcription_latin) and the shared v1.1 fields (source_citation, *_identified places, period_jurisdiction, person_aliases, vital_status, previous spouses, witness residences). Reuses the Horn H0135 derived schema's envelope. Do not invent certainty: keep [?], soft_fields, incomplete. Works for any parish (Lank, Horn, …).

stage_a_status.description: Status carried from / summarized from Stage A diplomatic QC

stage_b_status.description: Stage B lock state (already used by register owners; formalized v1.0.3/1.0.1/1.0.2).

stage_b_locked_at.description: When Stage B was locked (ISO date or date-time).

scan.description: Matricula scan id as used by the book's manifest (Lank: digits only, e.g. 118).

page.description: Printed/folio page on the face holding the entry.

crop_image.description: Primary (first) segment crop. Required. Must equal crops[0] when crops is set.

crops.description: Ordered crop paths for multi-leaf entries (page span). Index 0 = primary leaf (= crop_image). Length ≥1 when set. Single-leaf entries may omit crops or set [crop_image].

crop_image_continued.description: Convenience for exactly two leaves: second crop path (= crops[1]). Prefer crops[] when more than two or for uniform tooling.

diplomatic_path.description: Primary Stage A *.diplomatic.json (= diplomatic_paths[0] when that array is set).

diplomatic_paths.description: Stage A diplomatic JSON paths ordered to match crops[] (same length when both set). Index 0 = diplomatic_path.

diplomatic_text.description: Optional embed of Stage A diplomatic_text (else load via diplomatic_path)

source_citation.description: Source citation: Matricula image-page permalink + human-readable citation + structured parts. Nullable; existing records have none yet.

marriage_date.description: CSV rule: ISO YYYY-MM-DD when clear; partial YYYY-MM-?? / YYYY-??-?? or as written + [?]; eadem/eodem resolved to the prior dated entry (Latin word in notes). Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

groom_name.description: Groom primary name, person-field form (nominative; capitalized as Stephen rules). Alias NOT here → person_aliases.groom_name. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

groom_status.description: Marital status as written (viduus, caelebs, …). Never invent single. Blank/null if not stated; '?' if illegible. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

groom_previous_spouses.description: For a widowed groom: earlier wife/wives as named (e.g. Viduus Marie Margarethae Schüer[?] ex Schall.).

groom_residence.description: Groom residence as written (diplomatic per entry, without ex/in; e.g. Lathum, Schall.). Normalization goes in groom_residence_identified, not here. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

groom_residence_identified.description: Groom residence: as written vs identified gazetteer place (+ match_confidence). The string field stays the diplomatic value.

groom_father.description: Groom's father when the Latin gives parentage; never invent. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

groom_father_vital_status.description: Groom's father stated dead/alive at the event (status + words as written, e.g. defunctus, Ffti, selig).

groom_mother.description: Groom's mother when present; never invent. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

groom_mother_vital_status.description: Groom's mother stated dead/alive at the event (status + words as written, e.g. defunctus, Ffti, selig).

bride_name.description: Bride primary name, person-field form. Alias → person_aliases.bride_name. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

bride_status.description: Marital status as written (vidua, …); blank/null if not stated. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

bride_previous_spouses.description: For a widowed bride: earlier husband(s) as named (e.g. relicta vidua …).

bride_residence.description: Bride residence as written (diplomatic, without ex/in). Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

bride_residence_identified.description: Bride residence: as written vs identified gazetteer place (+ match_confidence). The string field stays the diplomatic value.

bride_father.description: Bride's father when present; never invent. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

bride_father_vital_status.description: Bride's father stated dead/alive at the event (status + words as written, e.g. defunctus, Ffti, selig).

bride_mother.description: Bride's mother when present; never invent. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

bride_mother_vital_status.description: Bride's mother stated dead/alive at the event (status + words as written, e.g. defunctus, Ffti, selig).

witness_1.description: First named witness (name only, nominative). Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

witness_1_residence_identified.description: Witness 1 residence (place_as_written carries the diplomatic form): as written vs identified gazetteer place (+ match_confidence). The string field stays the diplomatic value.

witness_2.description: Second named witness (name only, nominative). Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

witness_2_residence_identified.description: Witness 2 residence: as written vs identified gazetteer place (+ match_confidence). The string field stays the diplomatic value.

witnesses_other.description: Further named witnesses '; '-separated, or diplomatic unnamed classes (patribus, N vicino, et aliis …). Never invent names. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

witnesses_other_details.description: Structured copy of the further NAMED witnesses in witnesses_other (same order), each with residence. Unnamed classes stay only in witnesses_other.

banns_or_dispensation.description: Short normalized summary, e.g. '3 proclamationes; dispensatio', 'dispensatio 3 bannorum'. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

priest.description: Officiant as written/short form; 'à me parocho' / 'parochus' phrase if no name; never inherit a name from a prologue. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

marriage_place.description: Ceremony place only if the Latin states one distinct from residences. 'in facie Ecclesiae' → null. Never default-fill the parish church. Prefer null when absent ("" tolerated for CSV round-trip).

marriage_place_identified.description: Ceremony place (only when marriage_place is set): as written vs identified gazetteer place (+ match_confidence). The string field stays the diplomatic value.

period_jurisdiction.description: Historical territory / Amt / diocese at the event date. Reference the temporal gazetteer (source=gazetteer, place_id + as_of_date); editorial snapshot only for places not yet in the gazetteer.

person_aliases.description: Aliases (dictus / genannt / vulgo / condictus …) per person field; keys limited to this record's person fields. The person field keeps the primary name; the alias goes here (optionally also the legacy notes token, e.g. 'condictus: Brauns').

transcription_latin.description: Diplomatic Latin of the whole entry (= Stage A text; abbreviations and Stage A markers kept). Multi-column layouts: 'margin | place | main text | Testes' joined with ' | ', lines with ' / '.

expanded_latin.description: Reading/search form (see EXPANDED_LATIN_RULES.md): transcription_latin with abbreviations expanded (supplied letters in [ ], uncertain expansion [?]), wrap hyphens joined, ' / ' line breaks removed, margin prefixed as 'margin | '. Original spelling and æ kept. Nothing added beyond marks/wraps. null = not yet produced.

translation_de.description: Full-sense German. Locked marriage CSV requires DE/EN for complete rows; null allowed for incomplete fragments (open for Stephen: require at Stage B?).

translation_en.description: Full-sense English. Same policy as translation_de.

notes.description: Ambiguity, soft readings, eadem, date-order flags, continuations, witness quirks, cross-refs. Legacy alias token (conducta: X) optional now that person_aliases exists.

soft_fields.description: Map of field name → reason soft / alternate readings

incomplete.description: True while the entry is a page-break fragment (or fields not yet filled from continuation). False after continuation is locked and one Stage B record is complete.

continuation_note.description: Human note: where the text continues / prior leaf; e.g. continues scan 004 p16.

continues_entry_id.description: If this fragment will merge into / continues as another entry_id (continuation leaf), set that id here. Null when unknown or same entry_id after merge.

continued_from_entry_id.description: If this record is the continuation leaf (or merged record noting prior fragment), the entry_id of the prior incomplete fragment. Null when N/A.

place_ref.description: LEGACY free-form gazetteer link (kept for envelope parity). Use the *_identified place objects instead.

source_citation.description: Where the entry can be seen. All parts nullable: existing records have no URL yet. matricula_url is the canonical image-page permalink (viewer URL with ?pg=N), not the hosted-images JPEG.

matricula_url.description: Canonical Matricula viewer permalink to the image page, e.g. https://data.matricula-online.eu/en/deutschland/aachen/lank-st-stephanus/KB+999_3/?pg=2. Copy from the entry manifest matricula_url when present.

citation.description: Human-readable citation, e.g. 'Lank, St. Stephanus, Trauungen KB 999_3, scan KB_999-118, p. 252, entry 4. Matricula Online: <url>'.

archive.description: Holding archive as Matricula names it (e.g. 'Aachen, rk. Bistum'; 'Erzbistumsarchiv Paderborn').

matricula_collection.description: Matricula collection / parish code when the URL uses one (e.g. DE_EBAP_22212); null for slug URLs.

parish.description: Parish display name (e.g. 'Lank St. Stephanus'). The machine key stays parish_slug.

book_signature.description: Book signature as shown on Matricula (e.g. 'KB 999_3', 'KB005-02-H'). Usually = archival_id.

image_label.description: Matricula image label when known (e.g. KB_999-118).

page.description: Printed page / folio as cited (usually = page).

accessed.description: Date the URL was checked (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

place_identification.description: A place as written vs the identified real place. Superset of opr-place-ref v1.0.0 (places/place_ref.schema.json): residence_as_written is called place_as_written here because the same object is used for marriage_place / burial_place; place_id, as_of_date, match_confidence and notes are identical.

place_as_written.description: Place words as in transcription_latin (diplomatic: abbreviations, periods, [?] kept), without the governing preposition (ex / in / de) unless it is part of the name. E.g. 'Schall.', 'Berenbrok', 'Lanck ven Lüten'.

identified_name.description: Editorial/normalized name of the identified place (e.g. Schallern, Klieve). null when not identified.

place_id.description: Gazetteer id from /workspace/lank-schema/places/ (opr-place.place_id, e.g. place:lank). null until the place exists in the gazetteer.

as_of_date.description: Event date (ISO) used to pick time-bounded names/admin rows from the gazetteer.

basis.description: Why this identification (e.g. 'written in full', 'project identification', 'abbreviation of the groom's residence').

admin_level.description: Use the opr-place-admin admin_level vocabulary (herrschaft, amt, kreis, departement, state, country, deanery, …). Proposed additions pending Stephen: territory, diocese.

period_jurisdiction.description: Historical territory / Amt / diocese at the time of the event. The temporal gazetteer (places/place_admin.schema.json) is the source of truth: prefer source=gazetteer with place_id + as_of_date and resolve admin rows at query time (nothing is copied). source=editorial is a stop-gap snapshot for places not yet in the gazetteer; promote it into place_admin rows later.

place_id.description: Gazetteer place whose place_admin rows apply (event place, else residence, else parish seat).

editorial_levels.description: Only when source=editorial. Ordered broad → narrow or as known.

basis.description: Which place the jurisdiction was resolved for (e.g. 'parish seat', 'event place').

alias.description: One byname / alias of a person.

form.description: Alias in person-field form (capitalized, nominative), e.g. Schäper, Herweg, Brauns.

marker.description: Normalized marker lemma: dictus (dictus/dicta/dtā/dtʸ/dæ̱), genannt (gen./genannt), vulgo (vulgo/vulg.), condictus (cond./condictus/conducta/condicta), alias, other.

form_as_written.description: Alias as written when it differs from form (case, lowercase, [?]).

person_aliases.description: Map person field name → aliases of that person. The person field keeps the primary name only. Each record schema restricts the keys to its own person fields.

vital_status.description: Whether a named person (usually a parent) is stated to be dead at the time of the event, plus the words that say so.

status.description: deceased: defunctus/defuncti/Ffti/obitorum/selig/sel./†/p.m.; living: explicitly stated; uncertain: ambiguous wording (e.g. quondam = formerly or late).

as_written.description: Diplomatic word(s) from transcription_latin that carry the status (e.g. 'Ffti', 'obtōrum', 'quondam', 'selig'). For a couple-level word ('obtōrum Cjgūm') repeat it on both parents.

previous_spouse.description: Earlier spouse of a widowed bride/groom (or of the deceased).

name.description: Nominative person-field form; keep [?] and N.

name_as_written.description: Diplomatic form from transcription_latin (e.g. genitive 'Marie Margarethae Schüer[?]').

person_with_residence.description: Extra named participant (witness / sponsor) beyond the fixed slots, with residence.

notes.description: Role/title as written (e.g. 'Custos in Horn'), kinship, marks.
